name: graphiki
title: Graph-Based Knowledge Workspace
description: Build, explore, and analyze networks of ideas, people, and concepts with visual queries.
audience: Researchers, analysts, knowledge workers, and anyone who thinks in connections — people who need to map relationships between ideas, people, companies, or concepts.
useCases: Build knowledge graphs with nodes, relationships, and properties
Explore networks visually with interactive force-directed graphs
Query your data with visual boolean logic (AND/OR/NOT) and relationship traversal
Detect semantic duplicates using ML embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
Run graph analysis — PageRank, centrality, shortest path, clustering
Switch between graph and timeline views
Import/export data as JSON with smart matching

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored locally in the browser using IndexedDB. No server, no account, no data leaves your device.
dataPrivacy.export: Full graph exportable as JSON for backup or sharing.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: ML models run locally in the browser via Web Workers. No data sent to external APIs.
dataPrivacy.offline: Fully functional offline as an installable PWA.
